text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a canary in eu-west-1 where streaming SSE connections show up in the console but tenant metadata is empty. Quotas look misattributed.

maria: ugh. saw spikes in quota for unrelated tenants too. any logs? :eyes:

alex: pasted a minimal log snippet from the proxy:
```
INFO 2026-02-20T12:10:21Z proxy: forwarded request id=abc123, headers=[host:api.redwood.dev, x-client-id: user-xyz]
INFO 2026-02-20T12:10:21Z proxy: removed headers: [x-tenant-id, x-tenant-hash]
```

ken: whoa — the new edge gateway has a rule that hides unknown headers. Looks like `x-tenant-*` is being stripped.

linda: that would explain why the console can't map session -> tenant, so we fall back to session token parsing and sometimes double-count usage.

alex: yes. observed fallback code in runtime: when tenant header missing we parse token and then emit `tenant:unknown` telemetry, which downstream console tries to reconcile and sometimes attributes to last-seen tenant.

maria: can we add a defensive check in the console to mark sessions with missing header as `needs-proxy-check` so ops can triage without affecting billing?

ken: short-term: i can update the edge gateway to whitelist `x-tenant-id` and `x-tenant-hash`. long term we should sign-protect session metadata so proxies can't silently drop it.

ops-oncall: rolling rollback of the gateway rule to previous release in progress (canary only). Will alert when done.

deploy-bot: rollback started for gateway-canary-3 -> target eu-west-1 (job 789)

alex: suggestion for signature: include `x-session-sig` generated by control plane HMAC of `tenant-id|session-id|ts` so proxies can't modify/strip without detection. If sig absent, runtime should reject rather than silently fallback.

maria: agree. but need to be careful with perf on every SSE open — HMAC check should be tiny. also we need migration plan for existing sessions (versioned header). propose `x-session-v=2` and keep v1 fallback for 7 days.

ken: documenting a small config diff for nginx-ish proxy whitelist:
```
proxy_set_header X-Tenant-Id $http_x_tenant_id;
proxy_set_header X-Tenant-Hash $http_x_tenant_hash;
proxy_hide_header X-Some-Internal;
```

linda: sql telemetry query I ran to identify affected customers:
```
SELECT tenant, count(*) FROM sse_sessions
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
AND tenant IS NULL
GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20;
```
Found 6 tenants with weird spikes.

alex: plan proposal:
- emergency: rollback gateway rule (ops on it)
- short-term: whitelist headers in gateway canary and prod config
- medium: add console flag to mark `missing-tenant-header` sessions and exclude from billing until verified
- long-term: header signing (v2) + runtime strictness and migration window

ops-oncall: rollback complete in canary. watchers report quota back to baseline. opening postmortem ticket.

maria: i'll own the console flag and UI badge for triage. will push a PR with unit tests.

ken: i'll open gateway PR to whitelist headers + add test to the gateway integration harness.

linda: i'll add a dashboard tile for `sessions without tenant header` and a quick playbook for CS.

alex: thanks — can we also add an alert when >0.5% of new sessions in a minute are `tenant=null`? early detection would help.

ops-oncall: added alert rule to canary alert config. will roll to prod after monitor stability check.

deploy-bot: PRs created: gw#412, console#885, dashboard#112. Tagging for review.

maria: merging console patch after 1 more review. good catch team :thumbsup:
